name: Bench Press
description: The main horizontal pressing lift for the chest.
instructions: Lie on the bench with eyes under the bar and feet flat on the floor.
Grip slightly wider than shoulder width and unrack with straight arms.
Lower the bar under control to the mid-chest.
Press back up until the arms are straight, keeping shoulder blades pulled back.

name: Incline Dumbbell Press
description: Targets the upper chest on a bench set to about 30 degrees.
instructions: Set the bench to a 30–45 degree incline.
Start with the dumbbells above the upper chest, palms facing forward.
Lower until the elbows are slightly below the bench line.
Press up and slightly together without clashing the dumbbells.

name: Decline Bench Press
description: Bench press on a decline bench, emphasising the lower chest.
instructions: Secure your legs at the end of the decline bench.
Unrack the bar with straight arms over the lower chest.
Lower the bar to the lower chest under control.
Press back to the start position.

name: Dumbbell Bench Press
description: Flat pressing with dumbbells for a longer range of motion.
instructions: Lie flat holding the dumbbells at chest level.
Press up until the arms are straight.
Lower slowly until you feel a stretch in the chest.
Keep wrists stacked over elbows throughout.

name: Chest Fly
description: An isolation movement that stretches and squeezes the chest.
instructions: Lie flat with dumbbells above the chest, palms facing each other.
Keep a slight bend in the elbows.
Open the arms in a wide arc until you feel a stretch.
Bring the dumbbells back together over the chest.

name: Cable Crossover
description: Cable fly variation with constant tension.
instructions: Set both pulleys high and hold a handle in each hand.
Step forward with a slight forward lean.
Bring the hands together in front of the hips in an arc.
Return slowly until the arms are level with the shoulders.

name: Pec Deck
description: Machine chest fly with a fixed path.
instructions: Adjust the seat so the handles are at chest height.
Bring the handles together in front of you.
Pause briefly and squeeze the chest.
Return slowly to the start.

name: Push-up
description: Bodyweight pressing movement that needs no equipment.
instructions: Place hands slightly wider than shoulders, body in a straight line.
Lower the chest towards the floor, elbows at about 45 degrees.
Push back up to straight arms.
Keep the hips level and core braced.

name: Lat Pulldown
description: Vertical pull for the lats, a good alternative to pull-ups.
instructions: Sit with thighs under the pads and grip the bar wider than shoulders.
Pull the bar to the upper chest, leading with the elbows.
Squeeze the shoulder blades down and back.
Let the bar rise slowly until the arms are straight.

name: Seated Cable Row
description: Horizontal pull for the mid-back.
instructions: Sit upright with feet on the platform and knees slightly bent.
Pull the handle to the lower ribs.
Squeeze the shoulder blades together.
Extend the arms slowly without rounding the back.

name: Barbell Row
description: Bent-over row for overall back thickness.
instructions: Hinge at the hips with a flat back, bar hanging at arm's length.
Pull the bar to the lower chest or upper abdomen.
Pause, then lower under control.
Keep the torso angle steady throughout.

name: One-Arm Dumbbell Row
description: Single-arm row supported on a bench.
instructions: Place one knee and hand on a bench, back flat.
Row the dumbbell towards the hip.
Lower until the arm is straight.
Complete all reps, then switch sides.

name: Pull-up
description: Bodyweight vertical pull. Log added weight only if you use a belt.
instructions: Hang from the bar with an overhand grip, slightly wider than shoulders.
Pull up until the chin clears the bar.
Lower all the way down with control.
Avoid swinging.

name: Deadlift
description: Hip-hinge lift that works the whole back side of the body.
instructions: Stand with mid-foot under the bar, feet hip-width apart.
Grip just outside the legs, flatten the back and brace.
Push the floor away and stand up, keeping the bar close.
Lower the bar by pushing the hips back.

name: Squat
description: The main lower-body strength lift.
instructions: Rest the bar on the upper back and step out of the rack.
Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, toes slightly out.
Sit down and back until the thighs are at least parallel.
Drive up through the whole foot, keeping the chest up.

name: Leg Press
description: Machine press for quads and glutes with back support.
instructions: Sit with your back flat and feet shoulder-width on the platform.
Release the safety and lower the platform with control.
Stop before the lower back lifts off the pad.
Press back up without locking the knees hard.

name: Romanian Deadlift
description: Hip hinge that targets the hamstrings and glutes.
instructions: Hold the bar at hip height with soft knees.
Push the hips back and slide the bar down the thighs.
Stop when you feel a strong hamstring stretch, back flat.
Drive the hips forward to stand up.

name: Goblet Squat
description: Squat holding a dumbbell at the chest.
instructions: Hold one dumbbell vertically against the chest.
Squat down between the knees, chest up.
Go as deep as you can with a flat back.
Stand back up through the heels.

name: Walking Lunge
description: Alternating forward lunges. Log reps per leg.
instructions: Hold dumbbells at your sides.
Step forward and lower until both knees are at about 90 degrees.
Push through the front heel and bring the back foot forward.
Alternate legs as you walk.

name: Bulgarian Split Squat
description: Rear-foot-elevated split squat. Log reps per leg.
instructions: Place the top of your back foot on a bench behind you.
Lower until the front thigh is about parallel.
Keep the front knee tracking over the toes.
Drive up through the front foot.

name: Leg Extension
description: Quadriceps isolation on a machine.
instructions: Sit with the pad on the lower shins.
Extend the knees until the legs are straight.
Pause briefly at the top.
Lower slowly.

name: Lying Leg Curl
description: Hamstring isolation on a machine.
instructions: Lie face down with the pad above the heels.
Curl the heels towards the glutes.
Squeeze at the top.
Lower under control.

name: Standing Calf Raise
description: Calf raise on a machine or step.
instructions: Stand with the balls of the feet on the platform.
Rise as high as possible onto the toes.
Pause at the top.
Lower until you feel a stretch in the calves.

name: Hip Thrust
description: Glute-focused hip extension with the upper back on a bench.
instructions: Sit with the upper back against a bench and the bar over the hips.
Plant the feet hip-width apart.
Drive the hips up until the body is straight from shoulders to knees.
Lower with control.

name: Shoulder Press
description: Seated or standing overhead press with dumbbells.
instructions: Hold dumbbells at shoulder height, palms forward.
Press overhead until the arms are straight.
Lower back to shoulder height.
Keep the ribs down and avoid arching the back.

name: Overhead Press
description: Standing barbell press.
instructions: Hold the bar at the front of the shoulders.
Brace the core and squeeze the glutes.
Press the bar straight up, moving the head back slightly.
Lower to the shoulders with control.

name: Lateral Raise
description: Isolation for the side of the shoulders.
instructions: Stand holding light dumbbells at your sides.
Raise the arms out to the side to shoulder height.
Keep a slight bend in the elbows.
Lower slowly.

name: Front Raise
description: Isolation for the front of the shoulders.
instructions: Hold dumbbells in front of the thighs.
Raise one or both arms forward to shoulder height.
Pause briefly.
Lower with control.

name: Rear Delt Fly
description: Bent-over fly for the rear shoulders.
instructions: Hinge forward with a flat back, dumbbells hanging below.
Raise the arms out to the sides.
Squeeze the upper back at the top.
Lower slowly.

name: Face Pull
description: Cable pull to the face for rear shoulders and upper back.
instructions: Set a rope attachment at upper-chest height.
Pull the rope towards the face, hands moving apart.
Finish with elbows high and shoulders rotated back.
Return slowly.

name: Dumbbell Shrug
description: Shrug for the upper trapezius.
instructions: Hold dumbbells at your sides.
Lift the shoulders straight up towards the ears.
Pause at the top.
Lower fully.

name: Biceps Curl
description: Classic dumbbell curl for the biceps.
instructions: Stand holding dumbbells, palms forward.
Curl the weights up, keeping elbows at your sides.
Squeeze at the top.
Lower slowly to straight arms.

name: Barbell Curl
description: Biceps curl with a straight or EZ bar.
instructions: Hold the bar with an underhand, shoulder-width grip.
Curl the bar towards the shoulders.
Keep the elbows still and avoid swinging.
Lower under control.

name: Hammer Curl
description: Neutral-grip curl for biceps and forearms.
instructions: Hold dumbbells with palms facing each other.
Curl up while keeping the neutral grip.
Pause at the top.
Lower slowly.

name: Preacher Curl
description: Curl on a preacher bench to limit cheating.
instructions: Sit with the upper arms flat on the pad.
Curl the bar up towards the shoulders.
Lower until the arms are almost straight.
Do not bounce at the bottom.

name: Triceps Pushdown
description: Cable isolation for the triceps.
instructions: Stand at a high pulley with a bar or rope.
Keep the elbows pinned to your sides.
Push down until the arms are straight.
Let the handle rise slowly to about chest height.

name: Overhead Triceps Extension
description: Stretches and works the long head of the triceps.
instructions: Hold one dumbbell overhead with both hands.
Lower it behind the head by bending the elbows.
Keep the elbows pointing forward.
Extend back to straight arms.

name: Skull Crusher
description: Lying triceps extension.
instructions: Lie on a bench holding the bar above the chest.
Bend the elbows to lower the bar towards the forehead.
Keep the upper arms still.
Extend back to the start.

name: Close-Grip Bench Press
description: Bench press with a narrow grip to emphasise the triceps.
instructions: Grip the bar about shoulder width.
Lower to the lower chest with elbows close to the body.
Press back up to straight arms.
Keep the wrists straight.

name: Bench Dips
description: Triceps dips with hands on a bench behind you.
instructions: Place hands on a bench behind you, legs extended.
Lower the body by bending the elbows to about 90 degrees.
Press back up.
Keep the shoulders away from the ears.

name: Plank
description: Static hold for the core. Log the hold time.
instructions: Rest on forearms and toes with elbows under shoulders.
Keep the body in a straight line from head to heels.
Brace the abs and squeeze the glutes.
Breathe steadily and hold.

name: Side Plank
description: Static hold for the side of the core. Log time per side.
instructions: Lie on one side resting on the forearm.
Lift the hips so the body forms a straight line.
Hold without letting the hips sag.
Switch sides.

name: Crunch
description: Basic abdominal flexion.
instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent.
Curl the shoulders off the floor using the abs.
Pause briefly.
Lower slowly.

name: Hanging Leg Raise
description: Leg raise while hanging from a bar.
instructions: Hang from a bar with straight arms.
Raise the legs, bending the knees if needed.
Avoid swinging.
Lower slowly.

name: Russian Twist
description: Rotational core exercise. Log total twists.
instructions: Sit with knees bent and lean back slightly.
Rotate the torso from side to side.
Keep the chest up.
Add a weight only when comfortable.

name: Cable Crunch
description: Weighted crunch using a cable rope.
instructions: Kneel facing a high pulley holding a rope by your head.
Crunch down by flexing the spine.
Keep the hips still.
Return slowly.

name: Treadmill Run
description: Running or jogging on a treadmill. Log distance and time.
instructions: Start with a few minutes of walking to warm up.
Increase to a comfortable running pace.
Stay near the front of the belt.
Cool down by walking at the end.

name: Brisk Walk
description: Walking at a pace that raises your breathing.
instructions: Walk with an upright posture.
Swing the arms naturally.
Keep a pace where talking is possible but harder.

name: Cycling
description: Stationary bike. Log the duration.
instructions: Set the seat so the knee is slightly bent at the bottom.
Warm up at an easy resistance.
Hold a steady effort for the session.
Cool down at the end.

name: Rowing Machine
description: Indoor rowing. Log distance and time.
instructions: Push with the legs first.
Then lean back slightly and pull the handle to the ribs.
Return arms, body, then legs.
Keep a smooth rhythm.

name: Jump Rope
description: Skipping rope. Log the duration.
instructions: Hold the handles at hip height.
Turn the rope with the wrists.
Jump just high enough to clear the rope.
Land softly on the balls of the feet.

name: Kettlebell Swing
description: Explosive hip hinge with a kettlebell.
instructions: Stand with feet wider than hips, kettlebell in front.
Hike the bell back between the legs.
Snap the hips forward to swing it to chest height.
Let it fall back and repeat.

name: Burpee
description: Squat, plank, push-up and jump in one movement.
instructions: Squat down and place your hands on the floor.
Jump the feet back to a plank.
Jump the feet forward again.
Stand and jump with arms overhead.
